# Parley v0.1.68

This unnotarized test beta adds Ghostty's surface options to Settings, so a
pane's theme, cursor, scrollback and the rest are yours to set without a
Ghostty configuration file. Nothing changes in saved data or the agent
protocol.

## Ghostty options in Settings > Terminal

A fixed set of options for every pane's surface, each applied to all panes
the moment you change it and kept until you change it again:

- **Theme and colours:** a theme from Ghostty's bundled catalogue, chosen
  separately for the light and the dark appearance, and a minimum contrast
  that keeps faint text readable.
- **Font rendering:** glyph thickening and its strength, programming
  ligatures on or off, and line height.
- **Cursor:** shape, blink and opacity.
- **Background and padding:** background opacity and blur, horizontal and
  vertical padding.
- **Scrollback:** the history each pane keeps, 1 to 1000 MB. Ghostty's
  default is 50 MB.
- **Mouse and clipboard:** hide the pointer while typing, click to move the
  cursor at a prompt, copy on select, confirmation before pasting text with
  newlines, URL detection, scroll speed.
- **Shell integration:** the cursor, sudo, title and PATH features Ghostty
  installs in new shells.

Two options are read only when a pane is created: the scrollback limit and
the background opacity with its blur. Panes created afterwards use the new
value; running panes keep theirs. Settings says so beside them.

**Restore Ghostty Defaults** puts the whole set back. If Ghostty refuses a
value, Settings shows its message and keeps the previous options. An imported
Ghostty appearance (Settings > Appearance) still supplies colours itself, so
the two catalogue themes wait until it is removed.

The set is deliberately closed. No option can name a program, a file, an
environment variable or a key binding, and Parley still never loads a raw
Ghostty configuration file; what a pane runs stays with the agent launch
review. Help has a new *Ghostty surface options* section.

## Going back to v0.1.67

The options are stored as one preference; v0.1.67 ignores it and uses
Ghostty's defaults. Nothing else changes in saved reviews, workspaces or the
agent protocol (still 34).

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked before the pull request merged: 604 native checks, 82 script tests,
both scans, the build and the 25-round soak in a Command Line Tools Tart VM,
and the checks on GitHub's Xcode 26.6 runner. One check loads the default
and the everything-changed option sets through Ghostty's own configuration
parser. Not yet checked by hand in the app: the Settings form's controls
themselves, and the v0.1.67 items still waiting for a hand test.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
